description: Exploit: re-test a near-miss that was discarded on biased seeds, now priced at the new dial. E041 (remove 12 early 20 px steps) read −0.20 pp on seeds 3–12 right after those seeds selected E036, and that was already about the new 0.77 s/pp dial. On the E049 tip, remove only 12 steps from the 20 px phase (237 → 225). The 28 px and 32 px phases keep their exact absolute step counts. The whitening detach stays at the same absolute step, and the group-1 and group-2 freezes cover the same last absolute steps. The LR triangle and Lookahead ramp are stretched to the new total as fractions, as in E041. No new shapes; error_on_recompile stays on. Judge on 2 fresh builds × seeds 33–52 (40 draws) against E049's 60 draws, then the frozen gate on the single committed build.
